messages:
noah.p: FYI team — were launching Dedicated 'Kepler-600G' capacity in sa-east1 (sao-paulo) next Wed 2026-04-20 15:00 BRT. This is a GA-ready reserved pool but will have an initial soft-quota to stabilize placement. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/kepler-sao
tessa.prod: Quick Q: soft-quota meaning? will customers be blocked from self-serve?
noah.p: Soft-quota = self-serve reservations allowed but capped per-account for the first 72h. Well auto-review lift requests; priority to enterprise contracts.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning window: 2026-04-20 15:00-17:30 BRT. Expect minor CA rebalancing in sa-east1. No planned customer downtime.
marco.sre: Ops notes: Kepler-600G = 600 TOPS int8 class, 256GB HBM, optimized for large seq KV caching. Were shipping stricter tenant eviction thresholds initially to guard tail-latency. Default tenant replica cap = 3.
gina.sales: Heads-up for GTM: pricing will remain per-token; theres a temporary "early-access" uplift of 12% for new reservations in the first billing cycle. Please avoid promising unlimited capacity until we confirm pool utilisation.
devtools: Migration helpers? will console show auto-migrate or do manual requests?
noah.p: Console supports "request migration" flow with optional canary. Well also display recommended batch/kv settings and a one-click sample autoscale snippet in the Console.
marco.sre: Also adding that cross-region burst fallback will be disabled for Kepler for 48h after launch; this keeps traffic local and reduces noisy neighbor risk.
tessa.prod: Are there SLA or billing contract changes for committed Dedicated customers migrating?
noah.p: No SLA changes. Billing only differs with the temporary early-access uplift; full pricing applies after the stabilization period.
marco.sre: Oncall will monitor the window and will open an incident channel if we see elevated 5xxs or latency spikes. Tag @marco.sre if you notice anomalies.
gina.sales: Well hold outbound customer comms until the official product bulletin drops tomorrow 10:00 BRT. Please review the draft in #eng-runtime.
noah.p: Thanks all  small reminder: customers needing >3 replicas should file infra-ops with workload details; well triage.
